updater.//active: DISABLED until a signing keypair exists. `pubkey` is still the literal placeholder below, so with active=true every 'Check for updates' fails signature verification against a fake key. To re-enable: `pnpm tauri signer generate -w ~/.tauri/morgan-bevy.key`, commit the printed PUBLIC key into pubkey, set TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY + TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD as repo secrets, set active back to true, and add includeUpdaterJson: true to the tauri-action step in release.yml so latest.json is uploaded.
